claim: "Gyumolcs Insurance Agency" — 101 Interchange Plaza, Suite 103, Cranbury, phone 201-817-6127 (source: njtgo.com directory)
problem: The agency's own website lists a single office at 602 Higgins Ave., Suite 1, Brielle, NJ 08730 with phone 732-800-0741. Nothing on the opened page supports a Cranbury address, and Brielle is far outside the 10-mile Milltown zone. Directory entry is probably stale or wrong-town.
fix: Remove from the zone list, or downgrade to a flagged lead only if a second Cranbury office can be proven from the agency's own site or a Cranbury street address.

claim: "Head to Tails Grooming and Doggy Daycare" — 2670 US Highway 130, Cranbury, phone 609-860-9200 (source: yellowpages pet-grooming category)
problem: The business's own contact page gives 625 Mercer Street, Hightstown, NJ 08520 and phone 609-490-0014. The Cranbury address it was given is the same address as Love Your Dog Daycare, which looks like a directory conflation of two neighbouring businesses.
fix: Correct town and address to Hightstown (still inside 10 miles of Milltown, so keep only if the zone is a radius, not Cranbury township), add its website headtotailsnj.com, and re-check the phone.

claim: "Jazzercise Cranbury" — included in Group B with the note "owner-operated franchise studio... included with that caveat"
problem: A Jazzercise studio is a franchise/brand location, which the rules exclude, and the mapper applied that exclusion to RE/MAX, State Farm, Allstate, Minuteman Press, Roto-Rooter and SERVPRO. Leaving one franchise in makes the list internally inconsistent.
fix: Delete, or reclassify to a separate 'franchise/brand' file so triage does not spend time on it.

claim: Preschool/child-care entries: Montessori Preschool Academy, HoneyBee Montessori, Leaders In Learning Academy, Cranbury Presbyterian Nursery School (Group D)
problem: If the brief's "schools" exclusion covers licensed preschools and child-care centres, these four are excluded types. The mapper kept them and argued the case only for the church-based nursery school, so the decision was not applied consistently across the four.
fix: Confirm against the mapper's rules; if schools are excluded, drop all four (or keep all four with an explicit written exception if the brief allows child-care businesses).

claim: Branch offices / US subsidiaries of non-local corporations: Playmobil Inc., Hioki USA, Daler Rowney USA, Plymovent, Robotunits, Demarle, Main Tape, Hanwha International, Eastern Bag & Paper, Taylor Wiseman & Taylor, Prager Metis, Pine Environmental, Knapp's Cyclery (2nd store)
problem: These are satellite offices of multi-location or foreign-parent companies. The mapper excluded L'Oreal USA, Taro, Biocon, CMIC, Stada, Kronos etc. for exactly that reason, so the multi-location rule is applied inconsistently; several are also flagged 'borderline' in the notes without a decision.
fix: Apply one rule: either keep all multi-location/branch operations (and drop the L'Oreal/Taro-style exclusions as size-based only) or move all of these to a flagged/do-not-contact file.

claim: "Scandinavian American World" — categorized as "Specialty retail (Scandinavian goods)" at 108 N Main St
problem: The business appears to be Scandinavian American World Tours, a travel agency (directory listing at 108 N. Main St, 609-655-1600), not a retail shop. The category is wrong, which would mis-frame any outreach.
fix: Recategorize as a travel agency (or drop it if travel agencies fall outside the target segments) and re-verify that it is still trading.

claim: "Abel (staffing)" — employment agency at 2 Corporate Dr, phone unknown
problem: The business is Abel HR Services, a professional employer organisation (HR outsourcing), with phone 609-860-0400. Name, category and phone were all left incomplete or wrong.
fix: Rename to Abel HR Services, categorize as PEO/HR services, add 609-860-0400.

claim: "E. Martin Davidoff, Attorney at Law" — address/phone Unknown, no website, "one directory only"
problem: The practice is easily identifiable: Davidoff Tax Law, LLC, 1249 South River Road, Suite 305, Cranbury, phone 732-274-1999, own site taxattorneydavidoff.com. He is also Co-Partner in Charge of Prager Metis's national tax controversy practice, so this entry and the "Prager Metis CPAs" entry at 1249 S River Rd describe overlapping people at the same building.
fix: Fill in website/address/phone and note the Prager Metis affiliation so triage does not treat them as two unrelated prospects.

claim: Missing website fields for businesses that do have live sites
problem: CanDo Insurance (candoinsurance.com), Head to Tails (headtotailsnj.com) and E. Martin Davidoff/Davidoff Tax Law (taxattorneydavidoff.com) are all rated low or left blank even though their own sites open fine. Several other entries were left 'one directory only' without a site check.
fix: Re-run a quick site check for every entry with an empty website field before triage; add the domains found.

claim: "Knapp's Cyclery (Cranbury store)" — 34 N Main St, active evidence a 2026 Patch opening but a directory marking it closed
problem: Status is genuinely unresolved (Patch describes the September opening; bizarchive marks the Cranbury location closed; knappscyclery.com returns HTTP 403 to fetches). It is also a second location of a Lawrence Township shop.
fix: Confirm by phone or in person before treating as an active in-zone business; mark closed / dead-lead if not trading.

claim: Duplicate addresses: Stults Realty Co. and New Jersey Realty both at 37 N Main St; Love Your Dog Daycare and Head to Tails both at 2670 US Hwy 130
problem: Both pairs share a street address and are almost certainly one office or a directory mix-up; the mapper noted the first pair but not the second.
fix: De-duplicate (or merge with a note) before the list goes to triage.

claim: data_gaps say "No Cranbury Chamber of Commerce member directory exists online"
problem: Cranbury does have an active Cranbury Business Association with its own site (cbacranbury.com, verified open) that advertises member listings and events; the former Chamber merged into the Central NJ Chamber. The specific member page was not found at the guessed URL, so the source was not mined.
fix: Check cbacranbury.com member pages and event-sponsor lists as an additional coverage source; correct the data_gap wording.
